notes.title: Bloody Trapland 2: Curiosity out in 14 days!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5283151/26a706000282074ce8427143ae34ffedab91734b.png[/img]

[b]Time is moving rapidly towards official release of the sequel.
We are super excited to soon be able to bring you along for another adventure.[/b][i]

Join Jack, Henry, Jazzy and Blanky as they explore the Traplands.
Sail between the mysterious islands and solve the puzzles of the ancients.
Will you be able to uncover all the secrets in this one of a kind adventure?[/i]

[h1]New Features includes:[/h1]
[b][list][*] Story mode with 50+ Levels.
[*] Epic Boss battles.
[*] Hidden collectables and secrets.
[*] Challenge mode with randomly generated worlds.
[*] 31 legitimate Achievements.
[*] Easy to pick up, hard to master.
[*] Up to 4 player co-op.
[*] Online with dedicated servers, no setup needed.
[*] Local and Couch play support.
[*] Over the top powerful in game editor with full workshop support.
[*] Unlockable content only awarded to the persistent.
[*] Mysterious Skunk.
[/list][/b]
[h1]Make sure to whishlist for further updates:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/579840/Bloody_Trapland_2_Curiosity/

notes.title: Bloody Trapland 1.50 is now live!
notes.content:

notes.title: Trading Cards now live!
notes.content: Sorry for the delay, Valve has now approved our trading cards and they are ready for distribution.

notes.title: Updates & fixes!
notes.content:
We've just released a new patch. 
The new patch contains the following:

[b]Updates:[/b][list]
[*]Updated some levels to make them more fun!
[*]Added steam trading cards (Awaiting Valve's approval, will be released within a short period of time.)
[*]Steam achievements are now fully integrated (Images will be updated)
[*]Optimized the game to run better for those with low memory 
[/list]


[b]Bug fixes:[/b][list]
[*]Fixed some bugs caused by too many online servers.
[*]Fixed bug where game could crash in server lobby.
[*]Fixed achievements only unlocking working for hosts in online mode.
[*]Fixed bug in host screen where you could toggle between levels that don't exist.
[*]Fixed a memory leak caused by sound effects
[/list]

[b]Steam Trading Cards[/b]
We are glad to announce that we now offer Steam Trading Cards,
You will obtain cards just by playing the game which you can sell on the market or trade with other users, you can get a maximum of 3 cards by playing the game. You can craft a bloody trapland badge by getting a full set of 6 cards by trading or through the market. 
[b]Our official trading forum can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/257750/tradingforum/]here[/url].[/b]

There are 5 levels of badges to obtain + a special foil badge! 

There are 5 profile backgrounds to obtain from crafting badges. (3 common, 1 uncommon and 1 rare.)

There are 5 emoticons to obtain from crafting badges. (3 common, 1 uncommon and 1 rare.)

notes.title: Achievements and Reviews.
notes.content:
Hi Bloody Trapland Community,
We've added Steam Achievements to the game, you can now see these on your profile and on the achievement button on the Bloody Trapland page in the library.
The images used for the achievements are only temporary and will be edited in the future. If you find any bugs regarding these achievements please post it in the Bug Reports section on the discussions page.

Steam has recently added Reviews as a way for users to review games and allow users to get a quick look of reviews on a store page. Leave us some reviews on the store page and game hub and let us know what you think!

We are currently working on Steam Trading Cards, you will see this shortly.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Bloody Trapland, 20% off!
notes.content:
Bloody Trapland is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

Bloody Trapland is a fast-paced multiplayer platformer where the levels are filled with dozens of dangerous traps and tricky jumps that stand in your way!

Play co-op with your friends or take on the challenges on your own. With support for up too 4 players at once, local and/or online.

This is a challenging, yet simple game that anyone can enjoy, whether you're a casual or a hardcore gamer.

*Offer ends November 25 at 7AM Pacific Time
